reason: I’ll combine the cable and steel, which may make a way to separate iron-rich material from the spoil before processing.
expectation: I expect some kind of powered magnetic separator, though I’m not sure what form it will take.

alternatives.reason: Connecting the retort to hydrogen also seems relevant, but preparing the feedstock first seems practical.

effect: The cable and steel made a switchable electromagnet, so I can use it to prepare the feedstock.
reaction: The explanation of releasing the grains by switching off the current is satisfying.
reason: Separate the magnetic fraction of the screened regolith for processing.
expectation: I expect the magnet to collect an iron-rich fraction, though it may need further treatment.

alternatives.reason: The retort needs hydrogen, but I want to prepare its feedstock first.

effect: The magnet produced an iron-rich concentrate suitable for processing, according to the survey assay.
reaction: The distinction between the assay and the regolith's red color is a useful detail.
reason: Connect the retort to hydrogen so it can process the concentrate.
expectation: I expect a hydrogen-fed retort ready to receive the iron-rich material, though heating may still be needed.

alternatives.reason: Placing the concentrate at the heating bay also seems necessary, but I want the retort connected first.

effect: The retort is connected to a regulated hydrogen supply with contained exhaust, ready for heating and feedstock.
reaction: The containment detail makes the setup feel more physically grounded.
reason: Place the hydrogen-fed retort at the heating bay so it can process the concentrate.
expectation: I expect the retort to be positioned for solar heating; the concentrate will still need to be added.

alternatives.reason: The concentrate also needs to reach the bay, but positioning the retort first seems practical.

effect: The retort is positioned at the heating bay, making the concentrate-and-retort combination available.
reaction: The placement is a straightforward setup step.
reason: Add the concentrate to the hydrogen-fed retort for processing.
expectation: I expect solar heat and hydrogen to reduce the iron-bearing minerals, producing iron-bearing material and water; further processing may be needed.

effect: The heated hydrogen reduced the concentrate to porous, weak iron sponge, which has been carried to the press.
reaction: The explanation makes the reduction and need for further processing clear.
reason: Press the weak iron sponge into a more usable form; it is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the press to compact the sponge into a stronger iron form, though it may need further treatment.

effect: The heated, controlled-atmosphere press produced a dense iron billet; the new goal is to shape a process frame.
reaction: The distinction between consolidating the iron and shaping it is useful.
reason: Use the press to shape the billet into the needed frame; it is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the press to form a process frame from the consolidated iron, though it may require further assembly.

effect: The billet is now bars and brackets suitable for non-pressure supports, ready to build the process frame.
reaction: The distinction from flight hardware makes their intended use clear.
reason: Fit the iron supports to the return-plant footing; it is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the bars and brackets to form a process frame on the footing.

effect: The local iron supports now form a frame on the footing, completing the chapter's goals.
reaction: It's satisfying to see the processed material become a tangible part of the installation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reducing the concentrate in the heated hydrogen retort made the transformation from local minerals to usable material understandable, especially with the later consolidation step.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the retort at the heating bay was a necessary but uneventful setup step.

surprise.text: The assay detail clarified that the regolith's red color alone would not establish whether its magnetic fraction was suitable for iron production.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the sequence had clear purposes, although several later steps offered only one gameplay action.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see the gas installation completed and learn what the intact core reveals; the material-processing sequence gave me a reason to care about the equipment.
